A camera validation step must ensure required actors remain inside the safe visible region after projection.
A swarm simulator should verify both group spread and front-to-back ordering as entities move. Report failures with the affected entities and measured deviation.
A responsive UI check must detect anchor and margin drift when viewport dimensions change. Report failures with the affected viewport and measured deviation.

A multimodal judge must demonstrate that it inspected the supplied screenshot rather than guessing from surrounding task context.
